en.title: Manage academic citations
en.description: Find paper metadata, validate references, and prepare BibTeX entries.
tasks: Find paper metadata, validate references, and prepare BibTeX entries.
prerequisites: Python 3.9+, requests, and network access; scholarly for optional Google Scholar search.
en.example: Use citation-management. Check these ten DOIs, identify incomplete references, and export a verified BibTeX file.
en.expectedResult: A bibliography with validation notes and unresolved metadata clearly marked.
limitations: Database coverage and rate limits vary; optional NCBI credentials raise request limits.

zh.title: 管理学术引用
zh.description: 查找论文元数据、核验参考文献并准备 BibTeX 条目。
tasks: 查找论文元数据、核验参考文献并准备 BibTeX 条目。
prerequisites: Python 3.9+、requests 与网络；可选 Google Scholar 搜索需 scholarly。
zh.example: 请使用 citation-management：核对这十个 DOI，找出不完整引用，并导出已核对的 BibTeX 文件。
zh.expectedResult: 参考文献库、核验记录及明确标注的元数据缺口。
limitations: 数据库覆盖与限流不同；可选 NCBI 凭据可提高请求额度。
